title: Subterranean Echoes | ECHO//100 Episode 13
description: Kavi tumbles through the basement floor into a temporal pocket where the city lives in a perpetual, frozen loop. He must navigate the immune response of a reality trying to erase him before he loses his own existence. Episode 13 of ECHO//100: The Missing Hour. This is an AI-assisted original-fiction series.

scenes.text: The floorboards vanish, dropping Kavi into a neon metropolis pulsing with a frantic, rhythmic heartbeat.
scenes.caption: Falling into neon
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi in his red hoodie and backpack falling through a floor into a futuristic city, vertical cinematic, 3d animation

scenes.text: Passersby drift like ghosts, entirely unaware that they remain trapped within a ticking time loop.
scenes.caption: Ghosts of the city
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi walking through a crowded street of people frozen in motion, wearing red glasses, vertical cinematic, 3d animation

scenes.text: Byte flickers violently as the sky tears open, revealing Null’s jagged, dark purple claws descending.
scenes.caption: Null attacks
scenes.image_prompt: Byte with cyan face and orange antenna floating near Kavi, dark purple glitchy entity Null looming above, vertical cinematic

scenes.text: Null acts not as a villain, but as an immune system scrubbing this illegal pocket.
scenes.caption: Null is antibodies
scenes.image_prompt: Null looking down at Kavi with glowing red eyes, purple glitch patterns surrounding the city, vertical cinematic

scenes.text: Kavi represents the infection that Null intends to delete before the clock strikes the hour.
scenes.caption: Targeting the invaders

scenes.text: Kavi’s reflection fades, signaling that the timeline will soon forget Kavi ever existed here.
scenes.caption: Losing my identity

scenes.text: Suddenly, a warm hand grips Kavi’s shoulder, dragging the protagonist into a narrow, dark alley.
scenes.caption: A physical touch

scenes.text: Mira stands shivering, no longer a hologram, but a terrified girl made of living flesh.
scenes.caption: Mira is real
